part1.question: Do you work or are you a student? What specific aspect of your daily routine do you find most intellectually stimulating?
Where were you brought up? In what significant ways has your hometown evolved since your childhood?
How extensively do you incorporate artificial intelligence or automated digital tools into your daily workflow?
Do you prefer working or studying in complete silence, or do you find ambient background sounds helpful?
How do you usually occupy your time when you find yourself having to wait in long queues or delayed transit?
Are there adequate botanical gardens or public recreational parks in your city? How frequently do you visit them?
Did you ever attempt to master a musical instrument during your formative years? Would you consider doing so now?
Are you more disciplined during morning hours or late evening? How do you organize high-priority tasks?
Do you prioritize home-prepared culinary recipes, or do you prefer dining out with colleagues? Why?
What recreational physical activities do people in your country commonly engage in to maintain fitness?
Do you keep keepsakes or mementos from your childhood? Why do people hold onto nostalgic items?
How has instant messaging altered interpersonal relationships compared to traditional face-to-face dialogues?

part2.title: Describe an occasion when you had to wait a long time for something special or positive.
prompts: What you were waiting for and why it was meaningful
How long the waiting period lasted
What thoughts or emotions you experienced during the delay
And explain how you felt once the moment finally arrived.

part2.title: Describe a remarkably noisy place you spent time in recently.
prompts: Where this place was situated and when you visited
What particular sources created the excessive noise
What reason brought you to this location
And explain how this sensory overload influenced your state of mind.

part2.title: Describe an inspiring individual who encouraged you to pursue a creative or ambitious endeavor.
prompts: Who this individual is and how you initially encountered them
What creative or ambitious project they inspired you to tackle
How they mentored, advised, or supported your efforts
And explain why their encouragement was so pivotal to your success.

part2.title: Describe a demanding skill you attempted to learn that required considerable discipline.
prompts: What the skill was and why you decided to embark on learning it
What primary difficulties or learning curves you encountered
What strategies, teachers, or resources aided your progress
And explain whether you feel you have successfully mastered it.

part2.title: Describe an AI application or software innovation that radically transformed how you perform tasks.
prompts: What the software or application is and how you discovered it
What specific workflows or creative tasks you utilize it for
In what ways it outperforms conventional traditional methods
And explain whether you believe it could eventually lead to over-dependence.

part2.title: Describe an unusual or unexpected journey that deviated substantially from your original plans.
prompts: Where you intended to travel and who accompanied you
What unforeseen circumstances disrupted the initial itinerary
How you adapted and what alternative experiences transpired
And explain what you learned from navigating that unexpected deviation.

questions: Do modern instant-gratification digital services diminish patience in younger generations?
Why do people tend to appreciate rewards more intensely when substantial anticipation is involved?
In what professional contexts is long-term patient perseverance most indispensable?
Should city planning regulations enforce stricter acoustic zoning laws to curb urban noise pollution?
How does chronic environmental noise affect cognitive function and mental well-being over time?
Why do some individuals actively seek out bustling, loud environments rather than tranquil settings?
What distinguishes a genuinely transformative mentor from someone who simply gives instructions?
Do you believe schools cultivate enough creative independent thinking, or do they prioritize standardized metrics?
How does exposure to world-class artistic or scientific masters elevate communal aspirations?
Which skills will remain exclusively human as automation and algorithms continue to proliferate?
Why do many adults find it more intimidating to acquire new proficiencies compared to young children?
Should educational curricula prioritize generalist adaptability or deep specialized domain expertise?
Does widespread automation risk homogenizing human cultural expressions and literature?
Who should bear legal and ethical accountability when autonomous algorithms produce erroneous judgments?
How can educational institutions adapt evaluation methods in an era of pervasive generative AI?
In what ways do travel mishaps and unexpected setbacks shape emotional resilience?
How has algorithm-driven tourism and social media influenced the preservation of remote destinations?
Is the cultural value of slow, ground-based exploration being lost to rapid long-distance aviation?
